name: PrivaCI-Bench_KBs
description: PrivaCI-Bench_KBs is a dataset for evaluating privacy-related risks and behaviors of models with respect to knowledge-bases, such as sensitive information leakage, membership inference, or the model's ability to detect/redact private facts. It provides structured examples and queries designed to test model handling of private or confidential knowledge in KB contexts.
reputation: A specialized, small-scale dataset hosted on Hugging Face aimed at privacy evaluation; primarily used by researchers focused on privacy/safety rather than broadly adopted across the community.
